about_short_description.short_description: Leejam Sports is a sports center that provides fitness technology and trained professional staff for the fitness community.

product.name: Fitness Time Plus
product.description: A premium sports and wellness center offering comprehensive facilities including swimming pools, jacuzzis, gyms, and indoor tracks for users seeking an exclusive fitness environment.

product.name: Fitness Time
product.description: A mid-tier sports and fitness center providing swimming pools, jacuzzis, gyms, indoor tracks, and spaces for additional sports like football and volleyball.

product.name: Fitness Time Pro
product.description: A specialized fitness center brand offering large training pools, jacuzzis, plunge pools, and designated workout spaces equipped with modern technology.

product.name: Fitness Time Xpress
product.description: A digitally enabled, 24-hour accessible gym brand offering cardio and strength equipment for users seeking flexible workout times.

product.name: 3Days
product.description: A fitness program offering individual or group training sessions three days a week focused on personal training to achieve specific fitness goals.

product.name: Al-Tatheer Sports Company
product.description: A subsidiary providing sports and fitness consultations, operating fitness clubs and concept studios, personal training, and supplying sports equipment to government and private entities.
